targets.title: A lay theory of relational satisfaction with best friends.
targets.evidence_quote: Using data collected from a total of 513 Japanese college students, this study explored relational satisfaction with shinyuu(best/close friends) in Japan and provided a crosscultural comparison to the series of studies conducted by Cole and Bradac (1996).
targets.outcome_quote: Finally, Study 4 demonstrated that two of the dimensions are similar to dimensions identified in Cole and Bradac’s (1996) study. The third dimension, frank–supportive versus modest–self-controlled,was not found in Cole and Bradac’s study, whereas the first dimension of their study,spontaneous–active versus stable–passive,was not found in the Japanese data.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly identifies two similar dimensions and a dimension from the original absent in the Japanese data. No overall verdict overrides these comparisons.
